scope: Bounded computer-use walkthrough on the retained development service; release validation remains paused.
method: Native Firefox Developer Edition UI through computer use, with two isolated Multi-Account Containers and real Bitwarden passkey prompts.
starting_state: Neither disposable container offered a saved account. The operator authorized creating a fresh pair. This does not establish preservation of the previous browser accounts.
operator_actions: Saved and confirmed credentials for the fresh disposable account and joining device.
Explicitly confirmed intentional reuse of the older-labelled disposable Bitwarden entry before further login use.
Authorized persistent storage and entered a short Goals marker on A.
Completed the comparison-code approval and opened B's editor.
observations: B displayed A's original Goals marker and the same account identity.
A received B's first day card after returning from the certified ceremony page and unlocking.
B received A's reply card without a page reload.
A received a second B card without a page reload while both editors were open.
A was locked, its tab closed and restored, and its saved account opened through the chooser using the existing device-lock code and passkey. The Goals marker and all three cards remained visible.

B was locked, its tab closed and restored, and its saved device connection opened through the chooser using the existing device-lock code and passkey. No invitation was re-entered; the Goals marker and all three cards remained visible.
Both reopened editors displayed that the account login was remembered.
A received a fourth card added by B after both reopens, without another network-login ceremony or page reload.
result: Passed the fresh enrollment, initial content transfer, two-way editing, saved-connection reopen and post-reopen delivery walkthrough. Both disposable editors were left open for the operator.
product_notes: B's chooser entry still says Device connection with a workspace ID; its unlock page still says Connect this device and Unlock enrollment. Reopening nevertheless reached the editor directly after ordinary unlock.
not_established_by_this_walkthrough: Preservation or update uptake of an existing personal browser account
Offline reopening, browser-process crash recovery or eviction resistance
Device removal, replacement or repeated rotation through manual UI
